style.styleTitle: Hallmark Marvel Classic Avengers Comic Christmas Bauble
style.toneOfVoice: Add a heroic touch to your celebrations with this Keepsake hanging ornament featuring an iconic Marvel comic book. Perfect as a Christmas or birthday gift, or for adding to your Marvel collection. Made from hard-wearing resin, this detailed ornament features a classic Marvel Avengers 60th Anniversary comic book cover, showcasing Iron Man, Thor, Hulk and Ant-Man. Simply add a loop of twine, ribbon or thread (not included) to the metal ring to hang and display this collectible keepsake in your home. It s the perfect Christmas tree decoration or gift for Marvel fans. Hallmark Ornaments are a great way to commemorate hobbies, life events and individual interests in movies, games and more. Ornament Measures: H7.9cm by W5.6cm by D3cm. This is not a toy. For decorative use only. Dimensions(mm): Height: 79 Width: 56 Depth: 30.
